name: Music Saver
author: MrHogun
description: Shows the playing track as ASCII art with a live spectrum instead of the plain screensaver.

schema.label: Style preset
schema.description: ascii draws the cover with a 70-glyph letter ramp, blocks with shaded block characters, dots with dithered braille.

schema.label: Spectrum
schema.description: How the spectrum is drawn. auto follows the style preset: bars for blocks, ascii for ascii, dots for dots.

schema.label: Spectrum colours
schema.description: theme spreads the spectrum across the theme's terminal palette, accent paints it in one colour, cover pulls bright distinct colours out of the album art.

schema.label: Cover width
schema.description: Width of the cover in characters.
